claim: Muscularis macrophages communicate with enteric neurons through BMP2; neurons supply CSF1, and the circuit regulates smooth-muscle contractions.
caveat: Mouse muscularis externa, whereas these mucosal biopsies primarily sample muscularis mucosa. Broad labels cannot identify that macrophage subset. Reciprocal molecular signaling predicts neither equal nor unequal ARM prevalence. This is a retrospective anatomical consistency check, not causal validation.

claim: Paneth cells provide local Wnt to epithelial stem cells; subepithelial GLI1-positive mesenchymal cells provide a reserve Wnt source in mouse small intestine.
caveat: Epithelial is not a stem-cell label, and Fibroblast does not identify GLI1-positive cells. The literature motivates this three-type neighborhood, not compulsory simultaneous contact or a numerical spatial-arrow inequality. Epithelial labels were fixed in the mining null.

claim: The human ileal Crohn GIMATS module links inflammatory phagocytes, activated T cells, stromal cells and IgG plasma cells; its inferred cytokine network includes macrophage-to-T-cell and macrophage-to-stromal signaling.
caveat: This is a four-type spatial extension, not an established four-way 25-micron motif. The atlas lacks the required activation and IgG-subtype labels; its Plasma label is largely IgA-associated. Different organs and GVHD are not Crohn ileitis. Detection cannot validate GIMATS identity or its signaling direction.
